workspaceText: A workspace gathers all the resources of one ALERTE project: countries, institutions, knowledge bases, mandates, agents, permissions, scenarios, exercises and reports. The data of two workspaces stay isolated. A workspace is not a country, a scenario or an exercise: it is the container in which you build them.
